title: AMEP: Agentic Mandate Evidence Protocol
description:
AMEP is an open protocol for proving that actions taken by AI agents stayed within the authority a person delegated. It defines signed evidence objects for each link from a person's mandate to an independently observed effect, a deterministic three-valued evaluation (preserved, violated, unresolved) that names the invariant that broke, and a conformance suite of 118 vectors with two reference verifiers (Python and JavaScript, written separately by the same author).

This archive contains the specification (v0.2.0-draft.4), its bindings and profiles, JSON Schemas and CDDL, the conformance vectors, and the reference packages.
